## Details

<a id="copy_graphics"></a>
### [`copy_graphics`](../../../../src/init/copy_graphics.asm#L6) `$7E00`

*routine*

$6c00-$7bff goes to the sprites at $3000-$3fff. Then it stops the case change with SHIFT and C=. No inputs.
